summary: The Data Engineering Intern works with mentors to gain practical experience in building and maintaining data pipelines, databases, and analytics platforms.
responsibilities: Assist in designing and implementing data ingestion and processing workflows
Support data cleaning, transformation, and integration tasks
Learn to work with cloud data platforms and big data frameworks
Contribute to documentation and testing of pipelines
Participate in team meetings and technical discussions

education: Undergraduate or graduate student in Computer Science, Data Science, or related
Strong academic performance and interest in data engineering

skills_required.name: Understanding of data structures and algorithms
Eagerness to learn big data tools and cloud platforms
